rationale: Both Vadym and Esha share a core conviction that powerful technology—whether blockchain or AI—must be accessible to non-technical users to drive mainstream adoption. Vadym's 16+ years building user-friendly crypto products and Esha's experience scaling enterprise AI solutions at cloud giants (Amazon, Microsoft, Siemens) represent complementary perspectives on how to translate complex technology into intuitive, accessible products at scale.
intro_message: Vadym Hrusha, meet Esha Aggarwal — you both believe accessibility is the key to enterprise adoption, and could explore how product thinking bridges blockchain and AI adoption challenges.
